title: Rb3ContextFrame
description: Derived environmental context frame from the RB3 Gen 2 Vision Kit. Non-identifying, privacy-safe features only — no face recognition, no raw video. Phase 1 skeleton.

device_id.description: Identifier for the RB3 Vision Kit device.

ambient_lux.description: Estimated ambient lighting level in lux.

motion_load.description: Derived, unitless environmental motion/activity load estimate.

presence_detected.description: Whether a generic (non-identifying) human presence was detected in frame.
